description_en: Adds image information to an Image Search instance
description_zh: 本文为您介绍AddImage接口的语法及示例，用于向图像搜索实例中添加图片信息
name: AddImage

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Image Search instance. The name can be up to 20 characters in length.
If you have purchased an Image Search instance, log on to the Image Search console (https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/) to view the instance name.
If you have not purchased an Image Search instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179178.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66569.html.
The instance name is not the instance ID. Make sure you distinguish between the two
parameters.help_zh:
图搜实例名称。最多支持20个字符。
如果已经购买图搜实例可登录图像搜索管控台 (https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/)查看。
如果没有购买图搜实例可参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179178.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66569.html。
这里的实例名称并非实例ID，使用时请区分
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The product category of the image. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179184.html.
For product image search, if you specify a category, the specified category is used. If you do not specify a category, the system predicts the category. You can obtain the predicted category from the response.
<props="china">
For fabric, trademark, generic, home furnishing, and industrial hardware searches, the system sets the category to 88888888 regardless of whether you specify a category.
</props>
For generic image search, the system sets the category to 88888888 regardless of whether you specify a category
parameters.help_zh:
图片类目。具体请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179184.html。
对于商品搜索，若设置类目，则以设置的为准；若不设置类目，将由系统进行类目预测，预测的类目结果可在Response中获取 。
<props="china">
对于布料、商标、通用、家具家居和工业五金搜索，不论是否设置类目，系统会将类目设置为88888888。
</props>
对于通用搜索，不论是否设置类目，系统会将类目设置为88888888
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en:
The product ID. The ID can be up to 512 characters in length.

A product can have multiple images
parameters.help_zh:
商品ID，最多支持512个字符。

一个商品可以有多张图片
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en:
The image name. The name can be up to 512 characters in length.
The combination of ProductId and PicName uniquely identifies an image.
If you add images with the same ProductId and PicName multiple times, the last added image overwrites the previous ones
parameters.help_zh:
图片名称，最多支持512个字符。
ProductId和PicName唯一确定一张图片。
如果多次添加图片具有相同的ProductId和PicName，以最后一次添加为准，前面添加的图片将被覆盖
parameters.name: pic_name

parameters.help_en:
The image content, which is Base64-encoded.

The image size cannot exceed 4 MB.
Image formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, WEBP, TIFF, and PPM.
The transmission wait time cannot exceed 5 seconds.
<props="china">
For product image search and generic image search, the image width and height must be greater than or equal to 100 pixels and less than or equal to 4,096 pixels.
For trademark image search, the image width and height must be greater than or equal to 200 pixels and less than 4,096 pixels.
For fabric image search, the image width and height must be greater than or equal to 448 pixels and less than or equal to 4,096 pixels.
</props>
<props="intl">
For product image search and generic image search, the image width and height must be greater than or equal to 100 pixels and less than or equal to 4,096 pixels.
</props>
The image cannot contain rotation information
parameters.help_zh:
图片内容，Base64编码。

图片大小要求不超过4 MB。
图片格式：PNG、JPG、JPEG、BMP、GIF、WEBP、TIFF、PPM。
传输等待时间不超过5秒。
<props="china">
服务类型为商品图片搜索和通用图片搜索时，图片长和宽像素要求大于等于100且小于等于4096。
服务类型为商标图片搜索时，图片长和宽像素要求大于等于200且小于4096。
服务类型为布料图片搜索时，图片长和宽像素要求大于等于448且小于等于4096。
</props>
<props="intl">
服务类型为商品图片搜索和通用图片搜索时，图片长和宽像素要求大于等于100且小于等于4096。
</props>
图片中不能包含旋转信息
parameters.name: pic_content

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform subject identification. Default value: true.
If set to true, the system performs subject identification and searches based on the identified subject. You can obtain the subject identification result from the response.
If set to false, the system does not perform subject identification and searches based on the entire image.

<props="china">For fabric image search, this parameter is ignored and the system searches based on the entire image.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要进行主体识别。默认true。
为true时，由系统进行主体识别，以识别的主体进行搜索，主体识别结果可在Response中获取。
为false时，则不进行主体识别，以整张图进行搜索。

<props="china">对于布料图片搜索，此参数会被忽略，系统会以整张图进行搜索。</props>
parameters.name: crop

parameters.help_en:
The subject region of the image. The format is `x1,x2,y1,y2`, where `x1,y1` is the upper-left point and `x2,y2` is the lower-right point.
<props="china">
If you specify Region, the system searches based on the specified region regardless of the value of the Crop parameter.
For fabric image search, this parameter is ignored and the system searches based on the entire image.
</props>
<props="intl">
For fabric image search, this parameter is ignored and the system searches based on the entire image.
</props>
parameters.help_zh:
图片的主体区域，格式为`x1,x2,y1,y2,` 其中`x1,y1` 是左上角的点，`x2,y2`是右下角的点。
<props="china">
若用户设置了Region，则不论Crop参数为何值，都将以用户输入Region进行搜索。
对于布料图片搜索，此参数会被忽略，系统会以整张图进行搜索。
</props>
<props="intl">
对于布料图片搜索，此参数会被忽略，系统会以整张图进行搜索。
</props>
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The custom content. The content can be up to 4,096 characters in length.
This field is returned in query results. For example, you can add a text description of the image
parameters.help_zh:
用户自定义的内容，最多支持4096个字符。
查询时会返回该字段。例如可添加图片的描述等文本
parameters.name: custom_content

parameters.help_en: The integer attribute. This attribute can be used to filter results during queries. This field is returned in query results
parameters.help_zh: 整数类型属性，可用于查询时过滤，查询时会返回该字段
parameters.name: int_attr

parameters.help_en: The string attribute. The attribute can be up to 128 characters in length. This attribute can be used to filter results during queries. This field is returned in query results
parameters.help_zh: 字符串类型属性，最多支持128个字符。可用于查询时过滤，查询时会返回该字段
parameters.name: str_attr

Code.description_en:
The error code.

0: success.
Non-zero: failure
Code.description_zh:
错误码。

0：成功。
非0：失败

PicInfo.description_en: The information such as category prediction and subject identification results
PicInfo.description_zh: 类目预测、主体识别结果等信息

CategoryId.description_en: The category prediction result. If you specify a category in the request, the specified category is used
CategoryId.description_zh: 类目预测结果。若用户请求中指定了类目，则以请求中为准

Region.description_en: The subject identification result. The subject region of the image. The format is `x1,x2,y1,y2`, where `x1,y1` is the upper-left point and `x2,y2` is the lower-right point. If you specify the subject region in the request, the specified region is used
Region.description_zh: 主体识别结果。图片的主体区域，格式为`x1,x2,y1,y2`，其中`x1,y1`是左上角的点，`x2,y2`是右下角的点。若用户请求中指定了主体区域，则以请求中为准

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
